name: Golden Tobacco Ltd
about: Established in 1930 and taken over by Dalmia Group in 1979, Golden Tobacco Limited is engaged in manufacturing of Tobacco Products and Real Estate.
keyPoints:
Product Portfolio:[1]
a) Cigarettes:[2] Panama Mini Kings Special, Panama Filter, Panama Deluxe Filter, Taj Chhap, Golden's Gold Flake, etc.
b) Slim / Super Slim Cigarettes:[3] June Slim, June Super Slim, Lips
c) Cigars:[4] Just Black, Lips (In Barrel n Caps), June Slim Cigars
d) Cigarillos:[5] Just Black 108mm
Manufacturing Capacity:[6]
Company has it's own raw tobacco procurement division, based at Guntur which is capable of handling 10 million kgs of raw tobacco per season and a tobacco processing / blending division at Vadodara, with a capacity of 50 tons/day

cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -1.35% over past five years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.4.32 Cr.
Company's cost of borrowing seems high
